newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz could sell Isarweke stake to Viag.
newsitem.headline: Allianz could sell Isarweke stake to Viag.

text.p: German insurance group Allianz AG Holding said on Monday it might agree to sell its 10 percent stake in energy group Isarwerke GmbH to utility group Viag AG.
Chief financial officer Diethart Breipohl told the group's annual shareholder meeting that there was "clearly a possibility" of selling the stake.
Breipohl said that it made no sense for Allianz to insist on keeping a 10 percent stake in Isarwerke if another company held the overwhelming majority of shares in the group.
An agreement with Viag "would not be unwelcome", he said.
Isarwerke is the 80 percent owner of the Bavarian energy group Isar-Amperwerke, which Viag's energy unit Bayernwerk AG is keen to take over.
